_comment: Canned shipments for fetch_tracking_updates(). Supplier order references are generated at push time, so a fixture cannot know them in advance — the mock adapter therefore hands these out in order to whatever refs it is asked about, one per ref, cycling if it runs out. A real adapter would instead look each ref up against the supplier's API or shipment feed.
_shape: Each entry supplies the carrier and tracking number the adapter reports back for one order reference.
